name: Sheet-Pan Tandoori Chicken and Cauliflower
ingredients_verbatim: 1 cup full-fat coconut milk or plain coconut yogurt
2 tablespoons tandoori spice mix (no salt added)
1 tablespoon Diamond Crystal kosher salt or 1 1/2 teaspoons fine grain salt
1 tablespoon avocado oil or fat of choice
1 small cauliflower (2 pounds or less), cut into florets
1 small red onion cut into thin wedges
unmapped: tandoori spice mix (signature blend, no board home; garam masala/turmeric/paprika are on-board as components but the pre-mixed tandoori blend is not a tracked commodity)
avocado oil (no board home; olive-oil/vegetable-oil on board are direct substitutes)
why: Oven-only sheet-pan dinner that lands mid-band on the source's own numbers (590 cal, 20 g carb, 33 g protein per serving), giving comfortable headroom over the 400 floor and well under the 35 g carb ceiling when our own macros recompute. Structurally low-carb: chicken thighs + cauliflower + onion in a coconut-milk marinade, zero rice/pasta/potato/bread. Chicken thighs, cauliflower, red onion, coconut milk, cilantro, and lemon all map to the Omaha board; scales cleanly to 14 servings on sheet pans with weigh-and-divide. Adds Indian cuisine variety to an American/Tex-Mex-heavy catalog, and the tandoori spice mix is a deliberate unmapped flag to exercise the pricer lane.
